svg.title: Nacre electricity — generation, transmission and distribution
svg.desc: Ten country grid hubs connect renewable, nuclear or fossil generation to local distribution. The map shows in-service AC interties, the subsea HVDC cable connecting Orinthia, a normally open Brinax reserve tie, and the standalone Soreth grid.
svg.text: Schematic routes and sites · Basemap adapted from the Synthetic Exercise World atlas
